verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no data retention settings and no way to delete stored data, such as scans, OCR results, or AI summaries. The closest features are adjacent rather than the story's capability. 'Shred' destroys physical mail while explicitly keeping digital copies. Company deactivation only changes a status to inactive and does not delete data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
